method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Nvidia jumps 7% in after blockbuster earnings boost AI confidence
Equities.summary: Nvidia shares rose on Thursday after the chip giant's revenue guidance reassured investors that AI demand will remain strong.
Equities.reason: Clear market-moving equity news: Nvidia beat and guided strongly, reinforcing AI leadership and driving broader risk appetite. High directionality (positive for equities) and high relevance because Nvidia guides sector/market flows.

Equities.title: Nvidia forecasts 70% sales growth fuelled by relentless AI boom
Equities.summary: Chip giant says financing deals with customers are ‘excellent’ investments with ‘limited’ risk
Equities.reason: FT coverage of very strong NVIDIA guidance underscores the dominant AI-led equity narrative and suggests continued leadership-driven market upside; strong relevance to market regime.

Equities.title: Nvidia rises after signaling longer AI spending runway
Equities.reason: Reuters market-note that NVIDIA signalled extended AI spend supports risk-on and tech leadership themes; important market-wide implication though somewhat duplicative of earnings coverage.

Equities.title: CrowdStrike jumps 11% on record second quarter as 'Mythos moment' drives AI cyber wave
Equities.summary: CrowdStrike shares have surged 61% this year to new highs as the threat from frontier AI has fueled demand for advanced security tools.
Equities.reason: Company-level beat that reinforces the broader AI/ecosystem narrative and sector rotation into security software — positive for growth/tech sentiment but single-stock in nature so moderate relevance.

Equities.title: Salesforce stock jumps 12% on AI growth and Anthropic investment gain
Equities.summary: Salesforce's Anthropic stake led to higher profit in the latest quarter.
Equities.reason: Another large-cap beat tied to AI momentum and investment returns; supports the market leadership and thematic breadth of AI gains across mega-cap tech.

Equities.title: China industrial profits growth cools to slowest in seven months as economic slowdown deepens
Equities.summary: China's industrial profits growth in July slowed to its weakest pace this year, as soft demand and a broader slowdown in the economy weighed on manufacturers.
Equities.reason: Macro headwind: weaker China industrial profits imply softer global cyclical demand and increase downside risk for commodity-linked and cyclical equities; material regional/global relevance.

Equities.title: Six months of war: How the Middle East conflict has shaped financial markets
Equities.reason: Sustained geopolitical risk keeps a risk-premium in markets and can cap cyclical/EM performance; relevant as a persistent downside influence but not an immediate shock in this piece.

Equities.title: Meta settles social media addiction case with California, other states for $16.7 billion
Equities.summary: Meta and state attorneys general settled a federal trial centering on allegations that company misrepresented the extent of child-related mental health harms.
Equities.reason: Large legal settlement raises sector-specific headline risk for mega-cap social media/tech, increasing regulatory/legal overhang on equities; moderate relevance to market sentiment.

Equities.title: Billionaire India Broker Says Margin Lending Surge Is ‘Scary’
Equities.reason: Localized market-leverage concern (India) that flags potential vulnerability in regional equity flows; limited global relevance but worth noting as a risk signal.

Rates.title: Bank of Korea delivers back-to-back rate hikes as core inflation stays elevated
Rates.summary: The Bank of Korea hiked rates by 25 basis points to 3%, its highest since January 2025 and in line with expectations.
Rates.reason: Central-bank rate hike in a major APAC economy => upward pressure on local yields and tighter regional rates backdrop, negative for bond prices. High regional policy significance.

Rates.title: Economists See RBA Hike as Early as September After Hot CPI
Rates.reason: Market expectations shifting toward earlier RBA tightening after hotter CPI => Australian yields likely to rise, tightening local rates; relevant for APAC rates positioning.

Rates.title: PCE inflation rises 3.7% year over year in July
Rates.reason: Core US PCE (key Fed gauge) running hotter => increases odds of persistent higher policy rates / higher-for-longer pricing, puts strong upward pressure on US yields (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: TRADING DAY Hot inflation cools sentiment
Rates.reason: Market commentary linking hot inflation prints to weaker sentiment and repricing of rate expectations => immediate pressure on bond prices as yields rise.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, July 28–29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, July 28–29, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are high-signal for monetary policy stance and path; July minutes likely to influence market perception of Fed resolve on inflation and near-term policy, weighing on bond prices if they signal caution on cutting or intent to stay restrictive.

Rates.title: Thai Yield Gap May Narrow as Tame Inflation Boosts Long Bonds
Rates.reason: Article signals tame inflation supporting long Thai government bonds (yield compression) => positive for Thai bond prices; regional/EM local-market impact but limited global spillovers.

Rates.title: Indonesia’s Rupiah, Bonds Edge Lower as Investors Eye Protest
Rates.reason: Local political risk causing rupiah weakness and bond selling => upward pressure on Indonesian yields, regionally relevant EM rates move (negative for local bond prices).

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on July 20 and July 29, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on July 20 and July 29, 2026
Rates.reason: Board discount-rate meeting minutes provide insight into Fed lending/operational stance; modestly negative for bond prices if read as supportive of tighter liquidity or cautious policy operations.

FX.title: Euro zone lending growth picks up, ECB says
FX.reason: Direct ECB-linked data showing pickup in lending implies firmer euro‑area activity and potential for tighter financial conditions/monetary policy — near-term constructive for EUR vs USD.

FX.title: Europe’s gas stores are running low — and prices could top 100 euros this winter
FX.summary: Europe’s gas stores are historically low for this time of year, as disrupted Middle East LNG flows raise the risk of sharply higher prices this winter.
FX.reason: Tighter gas supplies and prospect of much higher euro‑priced energy raise stagflation risks for the euro area — boosts inflation but hurts growth and risk appetite, a net negative signal for EUR in FX markets.

FX.title: Euro stablecoins get a mainstream push as Revolut begins rolling out EURR in Europe
FX.reason: Mainstream rollout of a euro‑pegged stablecoin can incrementally deepen euro payment/settlement plumbing and dollar alternatives — structurally supportive for EUR liquidity and usage over time.

FX.title: ECB claims digital euro will offer 'maximum level of privacy' amid surveillance fears
FX.reason: ECB messaging on digital euro privacy addresses adoption barriers; positive for euro payment credibility and medium‑term currency infrastructure, but limited immediate FX impact.

FX.title: Piero Cipollone: From vision to delivery: building Europe’s tokenised financial market
FX.reason: ECB push on tokenisation and market infrastructure is a constructive structural development for euro liquidity/marketability, signalling modest long‑run support for EUR.

FX.title: Philip R. Lane: The rise in defence spending and the euro area economy
FX.reason: Analysis of higher defence spending implies fiscal and demand shifts in the euro area that could lift inflation and rates — a medium‑term positive for EUR via potential higher rates.

FX.title: Christine Lagarde: Panel remarks about the European economy during a discussion on the global economic outlook at the World Economic Forum
FX.reason: Lagarde's public comments on the European economy are ECB‑relevant but non‑specific here; small, marginally supportive signal for EUR given ongoing central‑bank policy focus.

Commodities.title: Gold drifts higher, eyes on Fed Chair Warsh's comments
Commodities.reason: Gold reacting to Fed commentary — Fed rate outlook is a primary driver of bullion. Fed-related moves are market-wide macro factors, so bullish drift on rate uncertainty is moderately relevant.

Commodities.title: Gold Consolidates Near $4,600 as Investors Weigh Fed Rate Path
Commodities.reason: Gold consolidation at elevated levels driven by Fed rate uncertainty — confirms persistent macro demand for safe-haven/real-assets exposure. Bloomberg piece reinforces the broader gold narrative (higher relevance).

Commodities.title: Longer wells boost Permian crude oil and natural gas production
Commodities.summary: Well operators in the Permian region of western Texas and eastern New Mexico are getting more oil and gas out of the ground by drilling longer, horizontal wells and increasingly incorporating so-called super-lateral wells that exceed 15,000 feet.
Commodities.reason: Technical improvements (longer/super-lateral wells) raise Permian oil & gas supply — a meaningful structural supply-side bearish impulse for crude and U.S. natural gas prices.

Commodities.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
Commodities.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Sh
Commodities.reason: Stronger waterborne flows from Gulf to West Coast ease regional product/crude tightness — modest bearish effect on regional fuel and crude differentials and overall supply balance.

Commodities.title: Kuwait and Qatar Add to Growing Oil Flows Getting Through Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Additional flows through Hormuz reduce a key geopolitical premium for oil shipments — material bearish implication for crude risk premium and global supply availability.

Commodities.title: Wheat Hits Three-Year High as Russia Prepares to Escalate War
Commodities.reason: Escalation-related supply risk out of a major producer (Russia) is a clear bullish driver for wheat; large price move and macro-food-security implications make this highly relevant.

Commodities.title: Oil Edges Lower as Traders Weigh Hormuz Talks, Russia Risk
Commodities.reason: Market marking down oil amid talks on Hormuz flows and balancing Russia-related risks — near-term bearish tilt for oil prices reflecting easing shipping premium.

Commodities.title: US Aims to Revive Civil War-Era Court to Claim Iran Oil as Prize
Commodities.reason: Legal/geopolitical maneuvering around Iranian oil could add supply uncertainty or seizure risk; signal is ambiguous but slightly bullish for oil risk premium — low-to-moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Soybeans Extend Gains to Tuesday’s Close
Commodities.reason: Price extension indicates tightening/firm demand or weather concerns — typical spot/technical move for soybeans with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Corn Closes Tuesday with Contracts Over $5 Across the Board
Commodities.reason: Broad contract strength signals supply/demand tightness or weather concerns — relevant for grain markets but a routine price report (moderate relevance).

Commodities.title: U.S. Refiners Face New Crude Squeeze as Canada Cuts Oil Sands Output
Commodities.reason: Canada cuts to oil sands lower North American crude supply into refineries — a material bullish supply shock for crude and refined products in the U.S. refining complex.

Commodities.title: Silver prices today, Tuesday, August 25, 2026: Silver prices pull back slightly, but remain over $68
Commodities.reason: Silver holding large monthly gains; piece is a short-form price update — modestly bullish but primarily technical/market-momentum relevance.

Commodities.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
Commodities.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
Commodities.reason: New pipeline capacity and completed projects improve logistics and flows of liquids — incremental bearish effect on regional bottlenecks and product differentials.

Commodities.title: Dangote refinery drives increase in petroleum shipments from Nigeria
Commodities.summary: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, playing an increasing role in the international market for petroleum products at a time when supplies from other areas have been constrained.
Commodities.reason: Dangote refinery has materially increased seaborne product exports from Nigeria, easing global product tightness — notable bearish influence on refined product markets.
